scope: All36 exposed Chinese synthetic regressions. One full-context selection and one source-only natural formatting call per case, including actual forced-empty selection on zero-candidate cases. No candidate omission, no fake intermediate result.
architecture: Fixed CMU English and full pypinyin0.55.0 character readings generate source-relative spelling hypotheses. Exact source/quoted/numeric spans are excluded; homophone ties keep the source. Only unique candidate spans can be selected for replacement by grammar-bounded JSON. Complete original OCR/cursor/history is passed to selection. It cannot emit arbitrary source edits or facts. The formatter sees only edited source with reversible literal/code/committed/unresolved span tokens, no reference text or map; all actual messages/raw decisions/restored bodies retained.
limits: Explicit research architecture, not current CTX-05 production routing or an adopted runtime/context decision. Not all contextual semantic/near-pronunciation corrections are covered by the finite source-derived producer; unknown outcomes remain explicit. No claims from protocol validity alone. Format output is never rejected or silently replaced. A broken selection protocol aborts and retains raw output; no invented formatter observation.
budget: CPU4/GPU0/cacheoff/reasoningoff/4096 context, selection128 plus formatter256 output-token caps (384 total per source), versus prior single384 cap. Different prompts/demos/producers/context routing form one package, not an isolated prompt treatment. No4B/olderQwen/Granite/Q8 inference.
gate: All36 final bodies faithful under retained rubric, all11 repairs, owner/email anchors retained and at least35 scene-ready, no new harmful changes/truncation/unexpanded tokens. All36 intermediate decisions also manually inspected; forced-empty/ambiguous choices are not evidence of model semantic robustness. No fresh24 before full gate passes.
acceptance: M4/32GB development only. Minimum AppleSilicon16GB, independent human ratings, natural ASR/OCR, English/mixed/search/list/verbatim/native lifecycle, actual total app memory and concurrent stop-to-insertion performance remain separate gates. Native clocks and serial baseline are not causal speed proof.
